description: Fix all 10 bugs identified in the second-pass audit. These are targeted fixes across tournament logic, shared components, and services.
steps: BUG 1 - TournamentHeader mute button active styling: In src/features/tournament/components/TournamentHeader.tsx around line 90, the button array object is missing an `active` property. Add `active: !audioManager.isMuted` to the mute button object so the map destructure picks it up and applies active styling. Remove the `as const` assertion since adding `active` makes the type incompatible with const-asserted inference that lacks the property.

BUG 2 - handleQuit incomplete PersistentTournamentState: In src/features/tournament/hooks/useTournamentState.ts around line 442-460, the handleQuit dispatch's defaultState payload omits `userName` and `lastUpdated` fields required by PersistentTournamentState. Add `userName: userName || "anonymous"` and `lastUpdated: Date.now()` to the defaultState object in the QUIT payload.

BUG 3 - handleVoteAdapter .name access on Team in 2v2: In src/features/tournament/Tournament.tsx around line 166-178, the sideData helper in handleVoteAdapter already has type narrowing for 2v2 mode using `'memberNames' in participant`. Verify this code properly handles all cases: Team (has memberNames), NameItem (has .name), and string. The current code at line 172-176 checks for memberNames first, then falls through to `.name` which is correct for NameItem but not for Team. However, the match type system ensures that in 2v2 mode, both sides are always Team objects with memberNames. If a Team object somehow lacks memberNames array content, the fallback uses `String(participant.id)`. This code is actually correct after PR #1227 already fixed it. SKIP if already correct, otherwise ensure the Team path properly joins memberNames.

BUG 4 - Completion effect .memberIds on string participants: In src/features/tournament/Tournament.tsx around lines 220-226, the completion effect iterates over matchHistory and accesses `leftSide?.memberIds` and `leftSide?.id`. For HeadToHeadMatch where left/right can be plain strings, these accesses yield undefined. Fix: Add proper type narrowing. For the memberIds check, when left is a string, memberIds is undefined (falsy) so it goes to the else branch `[String(leftSide?.id || "")]`. But for strings, `.id` is also undefined, resulting in `[""]`. Fix this by checking `typeof leftSide === 'string'` first and using the string value directly: `typeof leftSide === 'string' ? [leftSide] : leftSide?.memberIds ? leftSide.memberIds.map(String) : [String(leftSide?.id || "")]`. Same for rightSide.

BUG 5 - extractMatchData .name/.description on Team: In src/features/tournament/utils/matchHelpers.ts around lines 51-54, the extractSide function handles `typeof participant === 'object'` but doesn't distinguish between Team and NameItem. A Team object has `memberNames` and `memberIds` but no `.name` or `.description`. Add a check: if participant is an object and has 'memberNames' property, treat it as Team (join memberNames for name, no description). Otherwise treat as NameItem.

BUG 6 - Misleading static IV comment: In src/shared/lib/storage.ts line 12-13, the comment says 'Using a static IV for client-side obfuscation' but the static IV is now only used for legacy decryption fallback. Rename the variable from `ivHex` to `LEGACY_IV` and update the comment to say it's only used for decrypting legacy data that was encrypted before the random-IV change. Update all references to this variable (only in the decrypt function's default assignment).

BUG 7 - CatImage error state not reset on src change: In src/shared/components/layout/CatImage.tsx line 47, the useEffect that resets hasError has an empty dependency array `[]`. Change it to `[src]` so that when the src prop changes, the error state is cleared and the new image can attempt to load.

BUG 8 - sentryAdapter process.env.NODE_ENV: In src/shared/services/adapters/sentryAdapter.ts line 37, replace `process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"` with `import.meta.env.DEV` which is the Vite-compatible way to check for development mode.

BUG 9 - Lightbox keyboard event handling: In src/shared/components/layout/Lightbox.tsx, add a useEffect hook that registers a keydown event listener for: Escape (calls onClose), ArrowLeft (calls handlePrevious), ArrowRight (calls handleNext). Clean up the listener on unmount. Import useEffect from react.

BUG 10 - PersonalResults onSave misleading async: In src/features/dashboard/components/analytics/PersonalResults.tsx line 82-95, the onSave handler uses `await onUpdateRatings(ratingsMap)` but `onUpdateRatings` is a synchronous Zustand setter (`tournamentActions.setRatings`). Since the PersonalResults component doesn't have access to userName or ratingsAPI, add a clarifying comment that this only updates local state and does not persist to the server. Remove the unnecessary `async` and `await` to make the synchronous nature explicit, or keep async but add a comment. Prefer removing async/await since the function is synchronous.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run build succeeds without TypeScript errors
pnpm run test passes all existing tests
TournamentHeader mute button object includes an `active` property
handleQuit defaultState includes userName and lastUpdated fields
Completion effect in Tournament.tsx properly handles string participants without accessing .memberIds or .id on them
extractMatchData's extractSide function distinguishes between Team and NameItem objects
storage.ts static IV variable is renamed to indicate legacy usage with updated comment
CatImage useEffect has src in dependency array
sentryAdapter uses import.meta.env.DEV instead of process.env.NODE_ENV
Lightbox has keyboard event handlers for Escape, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight
PersonalResults onSave does not misleadingly await a synchronous call
